Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Riya - 11 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Hema - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Today feels like a good day."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Flower petals rain down on Rishabh.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Rishabh: "And then?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Rishabh: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Riya (gently): "Rishabh, listen!"

[Rishabh does yoga on a mat.]

Rishabh: "That's great!"

[Riya skips rope.]

Riya: "That was such a fun day!"
